dogecoin.text: @QuoteChain_AI Friend's grandpa only buys Dogecoin because "the dog looks friendly and trustworthy." His portfolio performance speaks infinitely louder than our sophisticated technical analysis charts ever could.

@QuoteChain_AI My grandfather in Sicily refuses to use any crypto except Dogecoin because “the dog reminds me of my neighbor’s mutt.” Has made more money than my entire DeFi portfolio. When I explain tokenomics, he just shrugs and says “the dog is honest.” Sometimes fundamentals matter less
